self.disposition: 7-point self-review. Two real findings, both fixed + tested: (1) the broad any-marketplace clone search was being used as the completeness authority, so a foreign marketplace's shared/ could be copied into this cache every session -> split into _same_name_shared (top-up) vs _find_marketplace_shared (restore), mutation-verified; (2) the shared/ copytree was unwrapped, so a failed shared copy skipped the plugins repair entirely -> isolated per tree and per mirror. Also confirmed fail-open, stdlib-only, LOC 299<300, ruff clean, and that _PLUGINS_SENTINEL left no dead references.

code.disposition: APPROVE conditional on 2 findings, both fixed. 10 findings (0 high, 3 medium, 7 low). Highest value: the ignore set was pinned against cache_tree_compare.SKIP_DIRS (the CHECKER) while update-marketplace.sh (the PRODUCER) withholds strictly more, incl. .python-version which all 14 plugins gained the same day - a latent phantom gap that would re-copy 1464 files every session once an install delivers one. Also: the trg id in architecture.md existed in no store; three stale references asserted the deleted _plugins_healthy still blocks the drift gate; two tests were weaker than their docstrings; _version_key equivalence unpinned. All fixed and re-tested.

DEFERRED with owners: fan-out serialization (trg-0c5af217, belongs with the hook-consolidation work, not inside 1 of 12 vendored copies); reaped-source basis and mirror-content coverage stated as assumptions (trg-5005bf57).

external_code.disposition: openai verdict=revise (3 findings), gemini degraded (truncated).
